units.title: F0–F6 证据过滤的专业理解
review_questions: 同源资金还缺真实交易时，为什么 F2 不通过且 F3 只能保留假设？
F4 上涨预测能力为何不能代替 F5 净可执行盈利？
event_at 早于 decision_at 但 available_at 晚于 decision_at 的数据能否作为交易特征？
解释任务是否需要 F5，监控发布是否需要人工批准？
success_conditions: Correctly distinguishes NOT_EVALUATED, INSUFFICIENT, REJECTED, NOT_APPLICABLE and evidence-backed PASS.
Can state a falsifiable mechanism plus at least one benign explanation.
Does not treat documents or fixture as real chain evidence or gate-pass proof.
units.notes: Draft educational content linked to existing F0–F6 policy; not independently signed off or installed in Grok.
